areas.label: area:core
areas.desc: the Rust core: domain, policy, adapters

risk_high: anything that can act on the outside world, the policy layer, authentication, secrets, CI/CD

verify.board: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test && cargo build --release
verify.extra: web: `cd web && npm ci && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test`; apps per `apps/*/README.md`

implementers.name: core-dev
implementers.description: Implements Rust work in the Atlas core — domain, policy layer, adapters, infra, docs.
implementers.rules:
- Async: tokio; never hold a `std::sync` lock across `.await`; bounded channels.
- Errors: typed where callers branch, `anyhow` only at the edges.
- Nothing acts on the outside world without going through the policy layer.

implementers.name: web-dev
implementers.description: Implements the Atlas web dashboard. Flow and states first, visual design only when the issue says so.
implementers.rules:
- No new runtime dependency without a justification line in the PR.
- Every state the UI can show has a test that renders it.

implementers.name: app-dev
implementers.description: Implements the Atlas companion apps — pairing, push, handoff.
implementers.rules:
- Device keys never leave the secure hardware store.
- Unit tests on the host; device runs are manual steps in the PR body.

mandatory_suites.red_when: a new misaction in the critical corpus, or a fixture left unrecorded
mandatory_suites.honest_line: 0 new critical misactions, pinned set unchanged

project_notes.fixtures: the dev fixture in Docker on port 8123 (`infra/dev/`); never bind a second instance
project_notes.offline_tests: CI has no fixture — tests use recorded responses
